name: Score recorder
design: Very tall narrow male with green-grey hide, sharp tapered forehead and exposed slim mandibles, long thin dreadlocks tied in low tail. Long charcoal sleeveless vest over golden ochre wrap tunic, slim bronze-edged sash, split knee panels and plain ankle wraps. A small angular blank-faced score slate held at chest height in left hand, stylus in right hand near surface; thoughtful relaxed stance.
